findings.suggested_fix: Split compound criteria, replace subjective terms with observable outcomes, and state how each is verified.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile child a3fa AC1/AC4 wording with parent AC4: state the guard as isinstance-PRIMARY WITH a hasattr FALLBACK and frame the divergence as being from ADR-0083's isinstance-only guidance (not from fetcher.py's hasattr), so the child delivers the parent's exact observable outcome.
evidence: Parent AC4: 'the guard is `isinstance`-primary with a `hasattr` fallback, a documented divergence from ADR-0083's isinstance-only guidance, because Python 3.12's `getattr_static` would declare a `__getattr__`-proxying transport non-capable.'
Child a3fa AC1: 'all four capability call sites are runtime-guarded with `isinstance` against the relevant `@runtime_checkable` capability Protocol before the call' (no hasattr fallback named).

Child a3fa AC4: 'the divergence from `fetcher.py`'s `hasattr` shape is justified in an in-code comment citing ADR-0083.' -- frames the divergence as being AWAY from hasattr, not TOWARD a hasattr fallback.
Child a3fa 'Guard shape' bullet: 'Guard shape: `isinstance(client, SupportsComments)` ... Deliberate documented divergence from `fetcher.py`'s `hasattr`.'

Confirming that the parent's shape is the true one: shipped code `if isinstance(client, protocol) or hasattr(client, member)` (dispatch_apply_phases.py:188) and child a3fa's own comment 'why the guard is isinstance-PRIMARY with a hasattr(client, member) fallback, not isinstance alone ... Filed as follow-up work against ADR-0083'.
findings.finding: Child a3fa's acceptance criteria, as written, describe a PURE-isinstance guard diverging AWAY from hasattr, which does not deliver the parent's AC4 observable outcome (an isinstance-primary guard WITH a hasattr FALLBACK, diverging FROM ADR-0083's isinstance-only guidance). AC1 says the sites are 'runtime-guarded with isinstance' and AC4 says the in-code comment justifies 'the divergence from fetcher.py's hasattr shape' -- i.e. the child frames the design as isinstance-only and consistent-with-ADR-0083, the opposite guard shape and opposite divergence direction from the parent AC4.
findings.location: child a3fa-e8d4-f4aa-4b51 (AC1, AC4, and the 'Guard shape' section)
scenarios: Completion verifier checks the child a3fa AC4 text (isinstance-only / divergence-from-hasattr) against the parent AC4 text (isinstance + hasattr fallback / divergence-from-ADR-0083) and finds the two describe contradictory guard shapes.
A reader of the child plan alone would implement an isinstance-only guard, which the child's own regression-test discussion shows breaks proxying transports and MagicMocks on Python 3.12.
findings.suggested_fix: Amend child a3fa AC1 to read 'runtime-guarded with an isinstance-primary check plus a hasattr(member) fallback' and AC4 to cite the divergence from ADR-0083's isinstance-only guidance (Python 3.12 getattr_static hazard), matching parent AC4 and the shipped dispatch_apply_phases.py:188 form.

findings.finding: Parent AC4 (AMENDED guard shape) is not covered by any child acceptance criterion, and its prescribed shape contradicts child a3fa's own body decision and ACs. The parent AC4 requires the guard to be 'isinstance PRIMARY with a hasattr(client, member) fallback' pinned by 'test_proxying_transport_is_capable_and_is_not_skipped behind a sys.version_info split', with the ADR divergence tracked in rebar:5c21-f24a-f7f8-4a55. Child a3fa's OPERATOR DECISION body and AC1 prescribe an isinstance-ONLY guard, and its AC4 only requires an in-code comment justifying divergence FROM fetcher.py's hasattr shape — the opposite direction. No child AC mentions the hasattr fallback, the proxying-transport/getattr_static hazard, the version-split test, or the 5c21 pointer.
findings.suggested_fix: Update child a3fa AC1 to 'isinstance-primary with a member-level hasattr fallback' and add an explicit AC (or fold into AC4) requiring the version-split proxy test and the 5c21 ADR-divergence link, so the child's ACs deliver the parent's amended AC4 observable outcome rather than the isinstance-only shape.

findings.finding: Child a3fa's guard-shape prescription conflicts with the parent's AMENDED AC4 (conflicting-assumptions mode).
findings.suggested_fix: Update child a3fa to adopt the parent's AMENDED AC4 guard shape verbatim and note the isinstance-only text is superseded, eliminating the contradiction.
